windows.name: Lirune Reader 6.0.0 — Major Release: Deep Reading-Theme Parity, 50+ Formats & Shell Integration
highlights: Over 50 Formats Supported: Open books, documents, comics, spreadsheets, and presentations in one simple reader
15 Beautiful Reading Themes: Seamless reading in dark mode, warm sepia, OLED black, and paper textures
Windows Explorer Integration: Double-click any book or document to open it immediately
One-Click Default Reader: Easily set Lirune as your default app in Windows Settings
Faster & Smoother: Instant book opening, smooth page zooming, and lightning-fast search
100% Offline & Private: No accounts, no cloud sync, and zero data collection

android.name: Lirune Reader v5.0.0 — Major Mobile Release: In-Reader Theme Parity & High-Performance Engine
highlights: Over 50 Formats Supported: Read EPUB, PDF, Kindle books, comics, and Office documents on your phone or tablet
Full Photo & Comic Support: Seamlessly view comics (CBZ, CBR) and modern camera photos (HEIC, HEIF)
Rock-Solid Library Import: Add individual books or entire folders quickly without errors
15 Curated Reading Themes: Beautiful eye-friendly palettes with true dark mode and sepia tones
Fluid 60fps Reading: Fast page turns, smooth scrolling, and instant startup
Zero Internet Permissions: Completely offline so your personal documents stay private
